WITH crypto AS (
SELECT date_bin('8 hours',ts,TIMESTAMPTZ '1970-01-01 00:00:00+00')+INTERVAL '8 hours' AS decision_time,
sum(ln(close/open)) AS btc_return,sum(power(ln(close/open),2)) AS minute_squared_return,
count(*) AS source_rows,count(DISTINCT ts) AS distinct_rows,min(ts) AS first_ts,max(ts) AS last_ts,
bool_and(open>0 AND high>0 AND low>0 AND close>0 AND high>=greatest(open,close,low) AND low<=least(open,close,high)) AS coherent
FROM bars_binance WHERE symbol='BTCUSDT' AND interval='1m' AND ts>=:start AND ts<:end GROUP BY 1)
SELECT c.*,f0.open AS usdjpy_open,f1.close AS usdjpy_close FROM crypto c
JOIN bars_polygon f0 ON f0.symbol='USDJPY' AND f0.interval='1m' AND f0.ts=c.decision_time-INTERVAL '8 hours'
JOIN bars_polygon f1 ON f1.symbol='USDJPY' AND f1.interval='1m' AND f1.ts=c.decision_time-INTERVAL '1 minute'
ORDER BY c.decision_time
